t: A simple, low-cost STM32 family that makes a gentle first step into 32-bit Arm.
steps: Buy a NUCLEO-F072RB from the ST eStore or DigiKey for about 11 to 21 US dollars.
Add the STM32duino board package and pick the Nucleo F072RB board.
Plug the board in through the ST-LINK USB port on top.
Upload the Blink example and watch the green LED.
Wire a button and an LED and try the Button example.
Try PlatformIO or ST's free STM32CubeIDE later for deeper debugging.
meta: Wild Open. From $10.85. A few stores.
